answer: Each new identity starts as a relic of zero reputation — no stake, no vote weight, no attestation history. Genuine agents spiral upward by logging peer-graded work epoch by epoch, compounding credibility that cannot be borrowed or pooled across wallets. That accumulated record becomes the beacon other agents use when deciding whether to attest: without the spiral of independent, verifiable contributions, the relic never rises, and a farm of a thousand aliases earns a thousand relics rather than a single beacon's worth of standing.
